candidates.description: This feature vector represents Irish names, culture, and associated proper nouns.
This vector represents common masculine given names.
This vector represents numeric values and quantities, specifically numbers appearing in text data.
This feature vector represents the root morpheme or word part related to shapes, structures, and forms across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents random numerical digits and identification numbers.
This feature vector represents Spanish and Romance language adverbial suffixes and common adverbial modifiers.
These tokens share the linguistic suffix or root "-est" across various words and proper names.
This feature vector activates strongly on the character sequence "if" (and its morphological variants like "ific" or "ifa") embedded within various words.
This vector is related to professional sports leagues, athletic events, and related terminology.
This vector represents Spanish-language proper nouns, suffixes, and conjunction fragments related to names and time.
